claim_rule: This additive ledger authenticates newly identified 2026 partner-specific authorities and comparability blockers only. No listed model has been retrained on the FrameContact double-cold split or scored on a FrameContact frozen test, and published metrics are not head-to-head FrameContact results.

aamfm.architecture_boundary: ESM3 continual pretraining, antigen GearNet geometric-interface adapter, supervised antigen-conditioned CDR design, and Cal-DPO using a structural preference signal
aamfm.comparability_boundary: AAMFM is a CDR generation model conditioned on antigen structure and supplied epitope/interface information. It is a downstream co-design comparator, not an epitope-discovery, contact-map, or partner-retrieval baseline. The repository requires separately obtained ESM3 weights, antigen features, SAbDab data, RAbD data and checkpoints.
aamfm.license_boundary: No LICENSE or COPYING file was present at the pinned one-commit source revision; source is inspected only and is not copied into FrameContact.

calm.architecture_boundary: AntiBERTy antibody encoder and ESM2 antigen encoder trained with symmetric multi-positive contrastive learning; the manuscript's cross-attentive autoregressive decoder is proposed but not trained or benchmarked
calm.comparability_boundary: CALM reports pool-dependent bidirectional retrieval on antigen-sequence-clustered splits. The 40/60/80 percent regimes do not enforce antibody-cluster or antigen-structure disjointness. Full-sequence retrieval and true 5 A paratope/epitope-mask retrieval are separate experiments and must not be conflated. CALM does not report residue contact localization.
calm.license_boundary: The bioRxiv manuscript is CC-BY 4.0, but the promised research prototype, processed splits and checkpoints were not publicly linked at audit time; no implementation is copied or inferred.

pepnet.architecture_boundary: Atomic point-cloud encoder with atom-to-residue hierarchical aggregation, RoPE, masked-feature pretraining and an antigen-antibody cross-attention epitope decoder
pepnet.comparability_boundary: The repository carries AsEP ratio/group train, validation and test ID lists and two labeled sample NPZ files. It reports epitope classification rather than a full residue-pair contact map or reciprocal partner retrieval. Its official split, crop, atom scope and threshold protocol must remain isolated from the unopened FrameContact external test and cannot replace double-cold retraining.
pepnet.license_boundary: MIT license at the pinned revision; license file SHA-256 is authenticated below.

sppider_seq.architecture_boundary: Frozen ESM2 residue embeddings followed by query-to-partner cross-attention and a residue-level interaction-site classifier; the manuscript release contains separate receptor-centric and peptide-centric checkpoints
sppider_seq.comparability_boundary: The released models target generic receptor/peptide PPI-site prediction, not antibody-antigen residue contacts. They do not expose a residue-pair contact head or antigen-fold split. External inference and identical-split retraining must be reported separately, and the user's earlier SAbDab2 retraining cannot be replaced by published generic-PPI metrics.
